basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old who recently joined Reddit to explore new hobbies and share my thoughts. Originally from Austin, Texas, I work as a graphic designer and have a keen interest in technology and modern art. I enjoy relaxing with some electroforming projects, which is a new hobby I picked up. I'm single and often browse Reddit in the evenings after work to unwind. I also have a budding interest in tech products, particularly new smartphone releases.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have worked in the field for 5 years. My interest in technology is largely self-taught, driven by online tutorials and community discussions. Recently, I've been diving deeper into electroforming as a creative outlet.
